before.name: Luis Dalhet Hipolito
before.description: Luis Dalhet Hipolito is a U.S. citizen arrested during a federal immigration enforcement operation in downtown Los Angeles on June 24, 2025. Prosecutors charged him with assaulting a federal officer. His defense said he believed masked men were abducting Andrea Velez and acted to protect her, and that he acted in self-defense after agents struck and pepper-sprayed him. He was detained and released on $10,000 bond. A federal jury later acquitted him of the assault charge.
